title: Age-based screening checks (Kazakhstan)
what: Free checks at the clinic where you are registered. They help find illness early. What is included depends on age and sex.
why: For adults at certain ages, on a schedule, usually once every few years. Ask your clinic for your own schedule.
duration: usually 1 to 2 visits; results in a few days
tell_doctor: What illnesses you have and what medicines you take
Heart disease, diabetes and cancer in close relatives
Which checks you have already had and when

prepare.title: Find out your turn
prepare.text: Ask at your registered clinic or in the app whether you are due for screening this year.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: For a blood test you usually come in the morning on an empty stomach. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Preparation
prepare.text: Some checks, such as a smear or a stool test, have their own preparation. It will be explained in advance.

steps: You come to your registered clinic
Blood pressure, height and weight are measured
You give the tests for your age
You have the required exams and tests
The doctor looks at the results and tells you what is next
after: If all is fine, the next check is on schedule
If something is found, you are sent to a specialist. That is not yet a diagnosis

faq.q: Do I have to pay for screening?
faq.a: Age-based screening is usually free. Check at your registered clinic.

faq.q: What if my age is not in the program?
faq.a: You can have an exam on a doctor's referral or pay for it. Talk with your doctor.

reminders.text: Screening tomorrow. Do not eat in the morning before the blood test, and bring your ID.
